## Models whose per-split accuracy differs between R and Python

For each such model the representation was rebuilt (sharedimp-py's AnchorResidualizer, training rows of the split), the Python learner of the job was refitted and R refitted `nnet::multinom(maxit = 500)` on the same files, as the built-in R learner does. This explains the difference; it does not alter the criterion.
